content:
Overview

Portsmouth is a city in NH with a population of 22,000. Historic seaport with Prescott Park, Strawbery Banke, and a vibrant restaurant scene. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
